convert_to_jsonable: convert a python value with torch tensors or paths into a JSON-serializable structure
write_atomic_checkpoint: write data to a temporary file then atomically rename it to the target path
safely_load_pickle: try to load a pickle file from a path and return None on any failure
import_module_or_fatal: import a python module by name and call fatal if the import fails
reliably_delete_directory: recursively delete a directory and move it to a trash folder if deletion fails
